home.lede: The foundations are in place: design tokens, the API, local services and the test pipeline. The storefront is built on top of these next.

status.title: System status
status.lede: Live checks of every service this site depends on. The page refreshes its data on every load.
status.unknownBecauseApiDown: Unknown while the API is unreachable.
status.redisDownImpact: The site keeps working. Rate limits are relaxed and background jobs wait until the cache is back.
status.apiDownHint: Start the API with pnpm dev, or check API_INTERNAL_URL in your .env file.
status.servicesDownHint: Start local services with pnpm docker:up.

notFound.title: We couldn’t find that page
notFound.body: The link may be out of date, or the page may have moved.

error.title: Something went wrong on our side
error.body: Your details are safe. Try again, and if the problem continues, contact us with the reference below.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.lede: Tokens and primitives every screen is built from. Values come from packages/config and switch with your system’s light or dark setting.
designSystem.motionHint: Hover or focus a tile to see each duration with the standard easing. Reduced-motion settings shorten these to a fade.
designSystem.moneyHint: Integer minor units formatted with Intl.NumberFormat for {locale}.
